item.title: Roshini Turner - "Know Your Strengths" - RugbyAsia247
item.description: Roshini Turner is a capped international with Hong Kong China XVs and has played with HKFC for several years, but became one of the very few Asian players to play in the PWR when she signed with Saracens in 2025.

item.title: Meiji Signs as Official Supplier of Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027 - RugbyAsia247
item.description: World Rugby has announced Meiji Co., Ltd as the Official Milk and Yoghurt Supplier of Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027 in Australia.

item.title: Asian International Rugby Tournaments 2026 - RugbyAsia247
item.description: There is still no confirmed list from Asia Rugby for the international tournaments in 2026, but several unions are also involved in World Rugby tournaments, including the new WXV format, Nations Cup and Nations Championship - we look at the Asian International Rugby Tournaments 2026.

item.title: China Women Fall Short of Qualification Aims For HSBC SVNS World Championship 2026 - RugbyAsia247
item.description: As the final leg of the HSBC SVNS Division 2 wrapped up in Sao Paolo, the Brazilian women claimed the final qualification spot by winning the home tournament, while the China Women's 7s fell short of qualification for the HSBC SVNS World Championship 2026

item.title: Japan U23 Tour of Australia 2026 - RugbyAsia247
item.description: The Japan U23 team has been selected for the Australia tour from April 1-15 2026, with the team set to face the U20 Fiji national team, the U20 Australia national team, Stockman Australia, and Randwick.

item.title: 2026 Cathay/HSBC Hong Kong Sevens – Fan's Guide On What You Need To Know - RugbyAsia247
item.description: The 2026 Cathay/HSBC Hong Kong Sevens will take place from 17-19 April at Kai Tak Sports Park and will be celebrating its 50th anniversary, with a busier Hong Kong Sevens week than ever before. We look at the rugby events, lunches, dinners, tournaments and other essential information for all the fans attending that week.

item.title: 2026 Cathay/HSBC Hong Kong Sevens Pools - RugbyAsia247
item.description: The pools for the 2026 Cathay/HSBC Hong Kong Sevens taking place from 17-19 April at Kai Tak Sports Park have been released, with 24 teams competing in the first of the three-tournament HSBC SVNS World Championship Series.

item.title: Hong Kong China Men's XV Head To South America for July World Rugby Nations Cup 2026 Fixtures - RugbyAsia247
item.description: World Rugby unveiled the match schedule for the inaugural World Rugby Nations Cup 2026, taking place throughout July and November 2026, and the Asian representation, Hong Kong China, will be playing three matches in South America.

item.title: Hong Kong China Rugby Announces Women's XV Coaching Setup for Asia Rugby Emirates Women’s Championship 2026 - RugbyAsia247
item.description: Kazakhstan will host the three-team Asia Rugby Emirates Women’s Championship 2026 tournament with defending champions Japan, Hong Kong, China, and the hosts competing from 28 April to 9 May, and HKCR has announced its coaching setup for the annual tournament.

item.title: Sanix World Rugby Youth Tournament 2026 - RugbyAsia247
item.description: The Sanix World Rugby Youth Tournament 2026 takes place from 28 April to Tuesday, 5 May at the Global Arena, Fukuoka, as the tournament celebrates its 27th edition.
